name: tr_martin
caption:
IF ALIJAH MARTIN WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🏈 Tauros, the quarterback: 2,100 passing yards and 1,300 rushing yards as a high school senior
🦉 Noctowl, the owl: helped Florida Atlantic to its first ever Final Four
🐊 Feraligatr, the gator: 2025 national champion with the Florida Gators
♟️ Pawniard, the pawn: our pick 39, on a two-way deal
👊 Scrafty, the grinder: G League All-Defensive Team and All-League Third Team
🔥 Charizard, the ace: 27 points at Milwaukee on 6-of-7 from three, 61.5% from three through 8 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: High school senior season as quarterback: passed for 2,100 yards and rushed for 1,300 yards; helped lead Florida Atlantic to the school's first ever Final Four; transferred to Florida, NCAA champion (2025); selected 39th overall (#39) by Toronto in the 2025 NBA draft, signed to a two-way contract; All-NBA G League Third (3rd) Team (2026), NBA G League All-Defensive Team (2026)
